title: Degree Adjacency Diametrical Matrix of Graphs Spectral Properties and Energy Bounds
summary: Graph matrices that combine structural and metric information have attracted considerable attention in spectral graph theory. In this paper, we introduce the \emph{Degree--Adjacency--Diametrical (DAD) matrix} of a connected graph $G$. The DAD matrix is defined by \[ (DAD(G))_{ij}= \begin{cases} d(v_i), & \text{if } i=j, 1, & \text{if } v_i\sim v_j, \operatorname{diam}(G), & \text{if } d(v_i,v_j)=\operatorname{diam}(G), 0, & \text{otherwise}, \end{cases} \] where $d(v_i)$ denotes the degree of the vertex $v_i$.
